open_divergences.name: trailing_token_after_double_quoted
open_divergences.description: a plain scalar and a colon after a closed double-quoted value on the same line
open_divergences.reason: yaml.v3 keeps a two-token scanner look-ahead behind the parser (yaml_parser_fetch_more_tokens, for comment association) while libyaml fetches a token only when the parser asks for it. The parser rejects the trailing token in both, but yaml.v3 has already scanned the ':' after it and reports the scanner failure 'mapping values are not allowed in this context' (with its own line), where libyaml reports the parser failure 'did not find expected key'
